name: AXM Hand Forge Bridge
actions: bind a missing-hand specification to its verification plan
map the bound contract into an Agent Tool Forge draft
build a deterministic provenance-enriched review package
export explicit EXPERIMENTAL review JSON or ZIP
summary: Adapts a source-bound missing-hand contract and verification plan into the existing deterministic Agent Tool Forge package format.
notes: Bridge output remains EXPERIMENTAL and review-only. It never installs, overwrites, executes, grants permission, promotes, releases or changes CANON.
